title: Emulation of Complex Matrix Multiplication based on the Chinese Remainder Theorem
summary: Modern computing architectures feature low-precision matrix multiplication units that achieve substantially higher throughput than their high-precision counterparts. Motivated by this architectural trend, the emulation of high-precision matrix multiplication using low-precision hardware has attracted significant interest in the high-performance computing community. Ozaki, Uchino, and Imamura proposed the Ozaki-II scheme as a general framework for emulating matrix multiplication. Building on this framework, Uchino, Ozaki, and Imamura developed high-performance and power-efficient techniques for emulating single- and double-precision real matrix multiplication on INT8 matrix engines. Extending this line of research, the present study proposes high-performance emulation methods for single- and double-precision complex matrix multiplication on INT8 matrix engines, based on the Ozaki-II scheme. On an NVIDIA B200 GPU, the proposed methods achieve 4.0--5.6x and 4.4--6.5x speedups over the native single- and double-precision complex matrix multiplication routines from cuBLAS, respectively, for sufficiently large problem sizes. When lower accuracy than that of the standard routines is acceptable, the proposed methods can operate at even higher speed. Conversely, with only a modest increase in computation time, they can deliver higher accuracy than that of the standard routines. These properties suggest that the proposed approach has the potential to serve as a default algorithm across a wide range of applications.

title: Single-Agent Scaling Fails Multi-Agent Intelligence: Towards Foundation Models with Native Multi-Agent Intelligence
summary: Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly assuming the role of the ''brain'' of AI agents. While recent efforts have begun to equip FMs with native single-agent abilities -- such as GUI interaction or integrated tool use -- we argue that the next frontier is endowing FMs with native multi-agent intelligence. We identify four core capabilities of FMs in multi-agent contexts: understanding, planning, efficient communication, and adaptation. Contrary to assumptions about the spontaneous emergence of such abilities, we provide extensive empirical evidence, across 41 large language models and 7 challenging benchmarks, showing that scaling single-agent performance alone does not automatically yield robust multi-agent intelligence. To address this gap, we outline key research directions -- spanning dataset construction, evaluation, training paradigms, and safety considerations -- for building FMs with native multi-agent intelligence.

title: A Systematic Evaluation of Preference Aggregation in Federated RLHF for Pluralistic Alignment of LLMs
comments: This paper is accepted at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Evaluating the Evolving LLM Lifecycle
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse human preferences within federated learning (FL) environments, where standard methods often fail to adequately represent diverse viewpoints. We introduce a comprehensive evaluation framework that systematically assesses the trade-off between alignment quality and fairness when using different aggregation strategies for human preferences. In our federated setting, each group locally evaluates rollouts and produces reward signals, and the server aggregates these group-level rewards without accessing any raw data. Specifically, we evaluate standard reward aggregation techniques (min, max, and average) and introduce a novel adaptive scheme that dynamically adjusts preference weights based on a group's historical alignment performance. Our experiments on question-answering (Q/A) tasks using a PPO-based RLHF pipeline demonstrate that our adaptive approach consistently achieves superior fairness while maintaining competitive alignment scores. This work offers a robust methodology for evaluating LLM behavior across diverse populations and provides a practical solution for developing truly pluralistic and fairly aligned models.
comment: This paper is accepted at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Evaluating the Evolving LLM Lifecycle

title: Unsupervised Learning of Density Estimates with Topological Optimization
summary: Kernel density estimation is a key component of a wide variety of algorithms in machine learning, Bayesian inference, stochastic dynamics and signal processing. However, the unsupervised density estimation technique requires tuning a crucial hyperparameter: the kernel bandwidth. The choice of bandwidth is critical as it controls the bias-variance trade-off by over- or under-smoothing the topological features. Topological data analysis provides methods to mathematically quantify topological characteristics, such as connected components, loops, voids et cetera, even in high dimensions where visualization of density estimates is impossible. In this paper, we propose an unsupervised learning approach using a topology-based loss function for the automated and unsupervised selection of the optimal bandwidth and benchmark it against classical techniques -- demonstrating its potential across different dimensions.

title: One Size Fits None: A Personalized Framework for Urban Accessibility Using Exponential Decay
summary: This study develops a personalized accessibility framework that integrates exponential decay functions with user-customizable weighting systems. The framework enables real-time, personalized urban evaluation based on individual priorities and lifestyle requirements. The methodology employs grid-based discretization and a two-stage computational architecture that separates intensive preprocessing from lightweight real-time calculations. The computational architecture demonstrates that accessibility modelling can be made accessible to non-technical users through interactive interfaces, enabling fine-grained spatial analysis and identification of accessibility variations within neighbourhoods. The research contributes to Sustainable Development Goal 11's vision of inclusive, sustainable cities by providing tools for understanding how different populations experience identical urban spaces, supporting evidence-based policy development that addresses accessibility gaps.

title: Training Multi-Image Vision Agents via End2End Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent VLM-based agents aim to replicate OpenAI O3's ``thinking with images" via tool use, but most open-source methods limit input to a single image, falling short on real-world multi-image QA tasks. To address this, we propose IMAgent, an open-source vision agent trained via end-to-end reinforcement learning dedicated for complex multi-image tasks. By leveraging a multi-agent system, we generate challenging and visually-rich multi-image QA pairs to fully activate the tool-use potential of the base VLM. Through manual verification, we obtain MIFG-QA, comprising 10k samples for training and evaluation. With deeper reasoning steps, VLMs may increasingly ignore visual inputs. We therefore develop two specialized tools for visual reflection and confirmation, allowing the model to proactively reallocate its attention to image content during inference. Benefiting from our well-designed action-trajectory two-level mask strategy, IMAgent achieves stable tool use behavior via pure RL training without requiring costly supervised fine-tuning data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IMAgent maintains strong performance on existing single-image benchmarks while achieving substantial improvements on our proposed multi-image dataset, with our analysis providing actionable insights for the research community. Codes and data will be released soon.

title: Almost-Optimal Approximation Algorithms for Global Minimum Cut in Directed Graphs
summary: We develop new $(1+ε)$-approximation algorithms for finding the global minimum edge-cut in a directed edge-weighted graph, and for finding the global minimum vertex-cut in a directed vertex-weighted graph. Our algorithms are randomized, and have a running time of $O\left(m^{1+o(1)}/ε\right)$ on any $m$-edge $n$-vertex input graph, assuming all edge/vertex weights are polynomially-bounded. In particular, for any constant $ε>0$, our algorithms have an almost-optimal running time of $O\left(m^{1+o(1)}\right)$. The fastest previously-known running time for this setting, due to (Cen et al., FOCS 2021), is $\tilde{O}\left(\min\left\{n^2/ε^2,m^{1+o(1)}\sqrt{n}\right\}\right)$ for Minimum Edge-Cut, and $\tilde{O}\left(n^2/ε^2\right)$ for Minimum Vertex-Cut. Our results further extend to the rooted variants of the Minimum Edge-Cut and Minimum Vertex-Cut problems, where the algorithm is additionally given a root vertex $r$, and the goal is to find a minimum-weight cut separating any vertex from the root $r$. In terms of techniques, we build upon and extend a framework that was recently introduced by (Chuzhoy et al., SODA 2026) for solving the Minimum Vertex-Cut problem in unweighted directed graphs. Additionally, in order to obtain our result for the Global Minimum Vertex-Cut problem, we develop a novel black-box reduction from this problem to its rooted variant. Prior to our work, such reductions were only known for more restricted settings, such as when all vertex-weights are unit.

title: FLARE v2: A Recursive Framework for Program Comprehension Across Common Teaching Languages and Levels of Abstraction
comments: 20 pages, 4 figures. Preprint under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
summary:
Building on the classroom framework in Heath et al. (2025), this paper proposes FLARE v2 as a recursive, semiotically informed account of how program meaning can be described across abstraction scales in common teaching languages. It reframes FLARE v1's tiers as one cycle: identify bounded elements (Receives, Sends, Effects, Shares), analyse bindings along two dimensions (Causal-Temporal and Communicative), and treat the bound set as a new element at the next scale. Causal-Temporal binding has three subtypes - Sequential, Branch, and Event - to distinguish user-authored control flow from event-driven control whose dispatch is hidden in the runtime. A Compositional Ladder visualises the same compositional move from blocks and statements through segments and systems.
  FLARE v2 is scoped to imperative and event-driven environments typical of primary and lower-secondary curricula. Above the system layer, behaviour is increasingly shaped by interaction between code and operating context (scheduling, infrastructure, permissions, contracts, failures, platform policy). Here, the element-and-binding vocabulary remains a structural baseline, but continuity of explanation typically requires overlays that make environmental constraints explicit. Event binding and overlays serve a common pedagogical role - preserving coherent structural reasoning where key causal mechanisms are not fully visible in the authored artefact. OOP design reasoning, explicit concurrency models, distributed systems, and functional paradigms are treated as future extensions; implementation and evaluation are left for future work.
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Preprint under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

title: CFLight: Enhancing Safety with Traffic Signal Control through Counterfactual Learning
summary: Traffic accidents result in millions of injuries and fatalities globally, with a significant number occurring at intersections each year. Traffic Signal Control (TSC) is an effective strategy for enhancing safety at these urban junctures. Despite the growing popularity of Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods in optimizing TSC, these methods often prioritize driving efficiency over safety, thus failing to address the critical balance between these two aspects. Additionally, these methods usually need more interpretability. CounterFactual (CF) learning is a promising approach for various causal analysis fields. In this study, we introduce a novel framework to improve RL for safety aspects in TSC. This framework introduces a novel method based on CF learning to address the question: ``What if, when an unsafe event occurs, we backtrack to perform alternative actions, and will this unsafe event still occur in the subsequent period?'' To answer this question, we propose a new structure causal model to predict the result after executing different actions, and we propose a new CF module that integrates with additional ``X'' modules to promote safe RL practices. Our new algorithm, CFLight, which is derived from this framework, effectively tackles challenging safety events and significantly improves safety at intersections through a near-zero collision control strategy. Through extensive numerical experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets, we demonstrate that CFLight reduces collisions and improves overall traffic performance compared to conventional RL methods and the recent safe RL model. Moreover, our method represents a generalized and safe framework for RL methods, opening possibilities for applications in other domains. The data and code are available in the github https://github.com/AdvancedAI-ComplexSystem/SmartCity/tree/main/CFLight.

title: MentraSuite: Post-Training Large Language Models for Mental Health Reasoning and Assessment
summary: Mental health disorders affect hundreds of millions globally, and the Web now serves as a primary medium for accessing support, information, and assessment. Large language models (LLMs) offer scalable and accessible assistance, yet their deployment in mental-health settings remains risky when their reasoning is incomplete, inconsistent, or ungrounded. Existing psychological LLMs emphasize emotional understanding or knowledge recall but overlook the step-wise, clinically aligned reasoning required for appraisal, diagnosis, intervention planning, abstraction, and verification. To address these issues, we introduce MentraSuite, a unified framework for advancing reliable mental-health reasoning. We propose MentraBench, a comprehensive benchmark spanning five core reasoning aspects, six tasks, and 13 datasets, evaluating both task performance and reasoning quality across five dimensions: conciseness, coherence, hallucination avoidance, task understanding, and internal consistency. We further present Mindora, a post-trained model optimized through a hybrid SFT-RL framework with an inconsistency-detection reward to enforce faithful and coherent reasoning. To support training, we construct high-quality trajectories using a novel reasoning trajectory generation strategy, that strategically filters difficult samples and applies a structured, consistency-oriented rewriting process to produce concise, readable, and well-balanced trajectories. Across 20 evaluated LLMs, Mindora achieves the highest average performance on MentraBench and shows remarkable performances in reasoning reliability, demonstrating its effectiveness for complex mental-health scenarios.

title: Binary and Non-Binary Self-Dual Sequences and Maximum Period Single-Track Gray Codes
summary: Binary self-dual sequences have been considered and analyzed throughout the years, and they have been used for various applications. Motivated by a construction for single-track Gray codes, we examine the structure and recursive constructions for binary and non-binary self-dual sequences. The feedback shift registers that generate such sequences are discussed. The connections between these sequences and maximum period single-track codes are discussed. Maximum period non-binary single-track Gray codes of length $p^t$ and period $p^{p^t}$ are constructed. These are the first infinite families of maximum period codes presented in the literature.

title: Geospatial Soil Quality Analysis: A Roadmap for Integrated Systems
summary: Soil quality (SQ) plays a crucial role in sustainable agriculture, environmental conservation, and land-use planning. Traditional SQ assessment techniques rely on costly, labor-intensive sampling and laboratory analysis, limiting their spatial and temporal coverage. Advances in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), remote sensing, and machine learning (ML) enabled efficient SQ evaluation. This paper presents a comprehensive roadmap distinguishing it from previous reviews by proposing a unified and modular pipeline that integrates multi-source soil data, GIS and remote sensing tools, and machine learning techniques to support transparent and scalable soil quality assessment. It also includes practical applications. Contrary to existing studies that predominantly target isolated soil parameters or specific modeling methodologies, this approach consolidates recent advancements in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), remote sensing technologies, and machine learning algorithms within the entire soil quality assessment pipeline. It also addresses existing challenges and limitations while exploring future developments and emerging trends in the field that can deliver the next generation of soil quality systems making them more transparent, adaptive, and aligned with sustainable land management.

title: Echo-CoPilot: A Multi-View, Multi-Task Agent for Echocardiography Interpretation and Reporting
summary: Echocardiography is central to contemporary cardiovascular care, but full-study interpretation remains a cognitively demanding, multi-view task that is still performed manually. While recent foundation models for echocardiography can achieve strong performance on individual perceptual subtasks such as view classification, segmentation, or disease prediction, they typically operate in isolation and do not provide a unified, clinically coherent assessment. In this work, we introduce Echo-CoPilot, a multi-view, multi-task agent that uses a large language model to orchestrate a suite of specialized echocardiography tools. Within a ReAct-style loop, the agent decomposes clinician queries, invokes tools for view recognition, cardiac structure segmentation, measurement and disease prediction, and report synthesis, and integrates their outputs into guideline-aware answers and narrative summaries. We evaluate Echo-CoPilot on the public MIMIC-EchoQA benchmark, where it achieves an accuracy of 50.8\%, outperforming both general-purpose and biomedical video vision-language models. Qualitative analyses further show that the agent leverages quantitative measurements and physiologic context to resolve challenging cases near clinical decision thresholds, such as borderline left ventricular hypertrophy or pericardial effusion severity. The code will be released upon acceptance of the paper.

title: Efficient Boys function evaluation using minimax approximation
summary: We present an algorithm for efficient evaluation of Boys functions $F_0,\dots,F_{k_\mathrm{max}}$ tailored to modern computing architectures, in particular graphical processing units (GPUs), where maximum throughput is high and data movement is costly. The method combines rational minimax approximations with upward and downward recurrence relations. The non-negative real axis is partitioned into three regions, $[0,\infty\rangle = A\cup B\cup C$, where regions $A$ and $B$ are treated using rational minimax approximations and region $C$ by an asymptotic approximation. This formulation avoids lookup tables and irregular memory access, making it well suited hardware with high maximum throughput and low latency. The rational minimax coefficients are generated using the rational Remez algorithm. For a target maximum absolute error of $\varepsilon_\mathrm{tol} = 5\cdot10^{-14}$, the corresponding approximation regions and coefficients for Boys functions $F_0,\dots,F_{32}$ are provided in the appendix.

title: Confucius Code Agent: Scalable Agent Scaffolding for Real-World Codebases
summary: Real-world software engineering tasks require coding agents that can operate over massive repositories, sustain long-horizon sessions, and reliably coordinate complex toolchains at test time. Existing research-grade agents offer transparency but struggle when scaled to real-world workloads, while proprietary systems achieve strong practical performance but provide limited extensibility, interpretability, and controllability. We introduce the Confucius Code Agent (CCA), a scalable software engineering agent that can operate at enterprise-level codebases. CCA is built on top of the Confucius SDK, an agent development platform structured around three complementary perspectives: Agent Experience (AX), User Experience (UX), and Developer Experience (DX). The SDK integrates a unified orchestrator with hierarchical working memory for long-context operation, a persistent note-taking mechanism for cross-session continual learning, and a modular extension system for reliable tool use. In addition, we introduce a meta-agent that automates the synthesis, evaluation, and refinement of agent configurations through a build-test-improve loop, enabling rapid adaptation to new tasks, environments, and tool stacks. Instantiated with these mechanisms, CCA demonstrates strong performance on real-world software engineering tasks. On SWE-Bench-Pro, CCA achieves a Resolve@1 of 54.3%, surpassing both research-grade and proprietary coding agents under comparable model conditions. Together, the Confucius SDK and CCA form a general, extensible, and production-grade foundation for building robust coding agents, bridging the gap between research prototypes and practical large-scale deployment.

title: Sliding Window Attention Adaptation
summary: The self-attention mechanism in Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) scales quadratically with input length, making long-context inference expensive. Sliding window attention (SWA) reduces this cost to linear complexity, but naively enabling complete SWA at inference-time for models pretrained with full attention (FA) causes severe long-context performance degradation due to training-inference mismatch. This makes us wonder: Can FA-pretrained LLMs be well adapted to SWA without pretraining? We investigate this by proposing Sliding Window Attention Adaptation (SWAA), a set of practical recipes that combine five methods for better adaptation: (1) applying SWA only during prefilling; (2) preserving "sink" tokens; (3) interleaving FA/SWA layers; (4) chain-of-thought (CoT); and (5) fine-tuning. Our experiments show that SWA adaptation is feasible while non-trivial: no single method suffices, yet specific synergistic combinations effectively recover the original long-context performance. We further analyze the performance-efficiency trade-offs of different SWAA configurations and provide recommended recipes for diverse scenarios, which can greatly and fundamentally accelerate LLM long-context inference speed by up to 100%. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuyijiong/sliding-window-attention-adaptation

title: Supporting Migration Policies with Forecasts: Illegal Border Crossings in Europe through a Mixed Approach
comments: 17 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables + supplementary material with 20 pages, 21 figures, 2 tables. Removed track changes from supplementary material. Corrected last figure number
summary: This paper presents a mixed-methodology to forecast illegal border crossings in Europe across five key migratory routes, with a one-year time horizon. The methodology integrates machine learning techniques with qualitative insights from migration experts. This approach aims at improving the predictive capacity of data-driven models through the inclusion of a human-assessed covariate, an innovation that addresses challenges posed by sudden shifts in migration patterns and limitations in traditional datasets. The proposed methodology responds directly to the forecasting needs outlined in the EU Pact on Migration and Asylum, supporting the Asylum and Migration Management Regulation (AMMR). It is designed to provide policy-relevant forecasts that inform strategic decisions, early warning systems, and solidarity mechanisms among EU Member States. By joining data-driven modeling with expert judgment, this work aligns with existing academic recommendations and introduces a novel operational tool tailored for EU migration governance. The methodology is tested and validated with known data to demonstrate its applicability and reliability in migration-related policy context.
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables + supplementary material with 20 pages, 21 figures, 2 tables. Removed track changes from supplementary material. Corrected last figure number

title: Immutable Explainability: Fuzzy Logic and Blockchain for Verifiable Affective AI
summary: Affective artificial intelligence has made substantial advances in recent years; yet two critical issues persist, particularly in sensitive applications. First, these systems frequently operate as 'black boxes', leaving their decision-making processes opaque. Second, audit logs often lack reliability, as the entity operating the system may alter them. In this work, we introduce the concept of Immutable Explainability, an architecture designed to address both challenges simultaneously. Our approach combines an interpretable inference engine - implemented through fuzzy logic to produce a transparent trace of each decision - with a cryptographic anchoring mechanism that records this trace on a blockchain, ensuring that it is tamper-evident and independently verifiable. To validate the approach, we implemented a heuristic pipeline integrating lexical and prosodic analysis within an explicit Mamdani-type multimodal fusion engine. Each inference generates an auditable record that is subsequently anchored on a public blockchain (Sepolia Testnet). We evaluated the system using the Spanish MEACorpus 2023, employing both the original corpus transcriptions and those generated by Whisper. The results show that our fuzzy-fusion approach outperforms baseline methods (linear and unimodal fusion). Beyond these quantitative outcomes, our primary objective is to establish a foundation for affective AI systems that offer transparent explanations, trustworthy audit trails, and greater user control over personal data.

title: Features Emerge as Discrete States: The First Application of SAEs to 3D Representations
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are a powerful dictionary learning technique for decomposing neural network activations, translating the hidden state into human ideas with high semantic value despite no external intervention or guidance. However, this technique has rarely been applied outside of the textual domain, limiting theoretical explorations of feature decomposition. We present the first application of SAEs to the 3D domain, analyzing the features used by a state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction VAE applied to 53k 3D models from the Objaverse dataset. We observe that the network encodes discrete rather than continuous features, leading to our key finding: such models approximate a discrete state space, driven by phase-like transitions from feature activations. Through this state transition framework, we address three otherwise unintuitive behaviors - the inclination of the reconstruction model towards positional encoding representations, the sigmoidal behavior of reconstruction loss from feature ablation, and the bimodality in the distribution of phase transition points. This final observation suggests the model redistributes the interference caused by superposition to prioritize the saliency of different features. Our work not only compiles and explains unexpected phenomena regarding feature decomposition, but also provides a framework to explain the model's feature learning dynamics. The code and dataset of encoded 3D objects will be available on release.

title: Pace: Physics-Aware Attentive Temporal Convolutional Network for Battery Health Estimation
comments: Accepted at the ACM Symposium On Applied Computing (SAC), 2026
summary: Batteries are critical components in modern energy systems such as electric vehicles and power grid energy storage. Effective battery health management is essential for battery system safety, cost-efficiency, and sustainability. In this paper, we propose Pace, a physics-aware attentive temporal convolutional network for battery health estimation. Pace integrates raw sensor measurements with battery physics features derived from the equivalent circuit model. We develop three battery-specific modules, including dilated temporal blocks for efficient temporal encoding, chunked attention blocks for context modeling, and a dual-head output block for fusing short- and long-term battery degradation patterns. Together, the modules enable Pace to predict battery health accurately and efficiently in various battery usage conditions. In a large public dataset, Pace performs much better than existing models, achieving an average performance improvement of 6.5 and 2.0x compared to two best-performing baseline models. We further demonstrate its practical viability with a real-time edge deployment on a Raspberry Pi. These results establish Pace as a practical and high-performance solution for battery health analytics.

title: PhraseVAE and PhraseLDM: Latent Diffusion for Full-Song Multitrack Symbolic Music Generation
summary: This technical report presents a new paradigm for full-song symbolic music generation. Existing symbolic models operate on note-attribute tokens and suffer from extremely long sequences, limited context length, and weak support for long-range structure. We address these issues by introducing PhraseVAE and PhraseLDM, the first latent diffusion framework designed for full-song multitrack symbolic music. PhraseVAE compresses an arbitrary variable-length polyphonic note sequence into a single compact 64-dimensional phrase-level latent representation with high reconstruction fidelity, allowing a well-structured latent space and efficient generative modeling. Built on this latent space, PhraseLDM generates an entire multi-track song in a single pass without any autoregressive components. The system eliminates bar-wise sequential modeling, supports up to 128 bars of music (8 minutes at 64 bpm), and produces complete songs with coherent local texture, idiomatic instrument patterns, and clear global structure. With only 45M parameters, our framework generates a full song within seconds while maintaining competitive musical quality and generation diversity. Together, these results show that phrase-level latent diffusion provides an effective and scalable solution to long-sequence modeling in symbolic music generation. We hope this work encourages future symbolic music research to move beyond note-attribute tokens and to consider phrase-level units as a more effective and musically meaningful modeling target.

title: Mirror Skin: In Situ Visualization of Robot Touch Intent on Robotic Skin
summary: Effective communication of robotic touch intent is a key factor in promoting safe and predictable physical human-robot interaction (pHRI). While intent communication has been widely studied, existing approaches lack the spatial specificity and semantic depth necessary to convey robot touch actions. We present Mirror Skin, a cephalopod-inspired concept that utilizes high-resolution, mirror-like visual feedback on robotic skin. By mapping in-situ visual representations of a human's body parts onto the corresponding robot's touch region, Mirror Skin communicates who shall initiate touch, where it will occur, and when it is imminent. To inform the design of Mirror Skin, we conducted a structured design exploration with experts in virtual reality (VR), iteratively refining six key dimensions. A subsequent controlled user study demonstrated that Mirror Skin significantly enhances accuracy and reduces response times for interpreting touch intent. These findings highlight the potential of visual feedback on robotic skin to communicate human-robot touch interactions.

title: Fast and Explicit: Slice-to-Volume Reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Primitives with Analytic Point Spread Function Modeling
summary: Recovering high-fidelity 3D images from sparse or degraded 2D images is a fundamental challenge in medical imaging, with broad applications ranging from 3D ultrasound reconstruction to MRI super-resolution. In the context of fetal MRI, high-resolution 3D reconstruction of the brain from motion-corrupted low-resolution 2D acquisitions is a prerequisite for accurate neurodevelopmental diagnosis. While implicit neural representations (INRs) have recently established state-of-the-art performance in self-supervised slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR), they suffer from a critical computational bottleneck: accurately modeling the image acquisition physics requires expensive stochastic Monte Carlo sampling to approximate the point spread function (PSF). In this work, we propose a shift from neural network based implicit representations to Gaussian based explicit representations. By parameterizing the HR 3D image volume as a field of anisotropic Gaussian primitives, we leverage the property of Gaussians being closed under convolution and thus derive a \textit{closed-form analytical solution} for the forward model. This formulation reduces the previously intractable acquisition integral to an exact covariance addition ($\mathbfΣ_{obs} = \mathbfΣ_{HR} + \mathbfΣ_{PSF}$), effectively bypassing the need for compute-intensive stochastic sampling while ensuring exact gradient propagation. We demonstrate that our approach matches the reconstruction quality of self-supervised state-of-the-art SVR frameworks while delivering a 5$\times$--10$\times$ speed-up on neonatal and fetal data. With convergence often reached in under 30 seconds, our framework paves the way towards translation into clinical routine of real-time fetal 3D MRI. Code will be public at {https://github.com/m-dannecker/Gaussian-Primitives-for-Fast-SVR}.

AI.title_translation: 快速且显式：基于解析点扩散函数建模的 3D 高斯原语切片到体素重建
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种使用 3D 高斯原语的显式模型进行切片到体素重建 (SVR) 的方法。通过利用高斯函数的解析特性，该方法推导出了前向模型的闭式解，从而避免了计算昂贵的随机采样。该方法在保持重建质量的同时，实现了 5 至 10 倍的速度提升，有望实现实时胎儿 3D MRI 的临床应用。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏或退化的 2D 图像中恢复高保真 3D 图像是医学成像的基本挑战，尤其是在胎儿 MRI 中，需要对受运动影响的低分辨率 2D 采集图像进行高分辨率 3D 重建以进行神经发育诊断。现有的先进隐式神经表示 (INR) 方法存在计算瓶颈，即准确建模图像采集物理学（点扩散函数 PSF）需要昂贵的随机蒙特卡洛采样。
AI.method: 提出从基于神经网络的隐式表示转向基于高斯的显式表示。将高分辨率 3D 图像体素参数化为各向异性高斯原语场。利用高斯函数在卷积下封闭的特性，推导出了前向模型的*闭式解析解*。这种公式将难以处理的采集积分简化为精确的协方差相加 ($\mathbf{\Sigma}_{obs} = \mathbf{\Sigma}_{HR} + \mathbf{\Sigma}_{PSF}$)，从而绕过了计算密集型随机采样，同时确保了精确的梯度传播。
AI.result: 重建质量与最先进的自监督 SVR 框架相当。在新生儿和胎儿数据上实现了 5 到 10 倍的速度提升。收敛通常在 30 秒内完成。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为实时胎儿 3D MRI 翻译成临床常规铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 从稀疏或退化的 2D 图像中恢复高保真 3D 图像是医学成像中的一个基本挑战，在 3D 超声重建到 MRI 超分辨率等领域具有广泛的应用。在胎儿 MRI 的背景下，从受运动干扰的低分辨率 2D 采集图像中高分辨率 3D 重建大脑是准确进行神经发育诊断的先决条件。虽然隐式神经表示 (INR) 最近在自监督切片到体素重建 (SVR) 中取得了最先进的性能，但它们面临一个关键的计算瓶颈：准确建模图像采集物理学需要昂贵的随机蒙特卡洛采样来近似点扩散函数 (PSF)。在这项工作中，我们建议从基于神经网络的隐式表示转向基于高斯的显式表示。通过将 HR 3D 图像体素参数化为各向异性高斯原语场，我们利用高斯函数在卷积下封闭的特性，从而推导出了前向模型的*闭式解析解*。这种公式将先前难以处理的采集积分简化为精确的协方差相加 ($\mathbf{\Sigma}_{obs} = \mathbf{\Sigma}_{HR} + \mathbf{\Sigma}_{PSF}$)，有效地绕过了对计算密集型随机采样的需求，同时确保了精确的梯度传播。我们证明了我们的方法匹配了自监督最先进 SVR 框架的重建质量，同时在新生儿和胎儿数据上提供了 5 倍至 10 倍的速度提升。由于收敛通常在 30 秒内达到，我们的框架为实时胎儿 3D MRI 转化为临床常规铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本文针对医学图像中的切片到体素重建 (SVR) 速度瓶颈，提出了一种快速且显式的 3D 高斯原语方法。该方法将高分辨率 3D 图像建模为高斯原语场，并利用高斯函数在卷积下的封闭性，首次为图像采集的前向模型导出了闭式解析解，将复杂的积分运算简化为协方差的直接相加。实验证明，该方法在保持与现有最先进 INR 框架相同重建质量的同时，实现了 5 到 10 倍的速度提升，有望加速实时临床应用。
AI.keywords: 切片到体素重建 (SVR), 3D 高斯原语, 解析点扩散函数 (PSF), 显式表示, 胎儿 MRI
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将隐式神经表示 (INR) 的范式转移到了显式的 3D 高斯原语表示。通过巧妙地利用高斯函数在卷积运算下的数学特性，作者成功地将先前需要昂贵的随机蒙特卡洛采样的 PSF 建模问题转化为一个精确的解析解。这种方法极大地解决了 SVR 领域中长期存在的计算效率瓶颈，尤其是在对实时性要求高的临床应用（如胎儿 MRI）中，30 秒内收敛的能力是实现临床转化的关键突破。这种对物理模型和表示方法的数学洞察，为未来的医学图像重建和逆问题求解提供了一个高效的新方向。

title: Enhancing Geo-localization for Crowdsourced Flood Imagery via LLM-Guided Attention
comments: Updated author list to include additional contributor. Revised title and improved methodology section based on collaborative feedback
summary: Crowdsourced street-view imagery from social media provides real-time visual evidence of urban flooding and other crisis events, yet it often lacks reliable geographic metadata for emergency response. Existing image geo-localization approaches, also known as Visual Place Recognition (VPR) models, exhibit substantial performance degradation when applied to such imagery due to visual distortions and domain shifts in cross-source scenarios. This paper presents VPR-AttLLM, a model-agnostic framework that integrates the semantic reasoning and geo-knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) into established VPR pipelines through attention-guided descriptor enhancement. By leveraging LLMs to identify location-informative regions within the city context and suppress visual noise, VPR-AttLLM improves retrieval performance without requiring model retraining or additional data. Comprehensive evaluations are conducted on extended benchmarks including SF-XL enriched with real social-media flood images, synthetic flooding scenarios over established query sets and Mapillary photos, and a new HK-URBAN dataset capturing morphologically distinct cityscapes. Integrating VPR-AttLLM with three state-of-the-art VPR models-CosPlace, EigenPlaces, and SALAD-consistently improves recall performance, yielding relative gains typically between 1-3% and reaching up to 8% on the most challenging real flood imagery. Beyond measurable gains in retrieval accuracy, this study establishes a generalizable paradigm for LLM-guided multimodal fusion in visual retrieval systems. By embedding principles from urban perception theory into attention mechanisms, VPR-AttLLM bridges human-like spatial reasoning with modern VPR architectures. Its plug-and-play design, strong cross-source robustness, and interpretability highlight its potential for scalable urban monitoring and rapid geo-localization of crowdsourced crisis imagery.

AI.title_translation: 通过LLM引导的注意力增强众包洪水图像的地理定位
AI.tldr: 提出了VPR-AttLLM，它利用LLM引导注意力来增强众包洪水图像的地理定位。该即插即用框架通过识别关键位置区域和抑制噪声，无需重新训练即可将现有VPR模型的性能提高1%至8%，在危机图像定位中具有巨大潜力。
AI.motivation: 众包街景图像缺乏可靠的地理元数据，而现有的视觉地点识别（VPR）模型在应用于此类图像时，由于视觉失真和跨源域偏移，性能会大幅下降。
AI.method: 提出了VPR-AttLLM，这是一个与模型无关的框架。它通过注意力引导的描述符增强，将大型语言模型（LLMs）的语义推理和地理知识整合到现有的VPR流程中。LLMs用于识别城市背景中具有位置信息意义的区域并抑制视觉噪声。
AI.result: 在与三种最先进的VPR模型（CosPlace、EigenPlaces和SALAD）集成时，VPR-AttLLM持续提高了召回性能，相对增益通常在1-3%之间，在最具挑战性的真实洪水图像上高达8%。评估使用了扩展的SF-XL（包含真实洪水图像）、合成洪水场景和新的HK-URBAN数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一种可泛化的范式，用于视觉检索系统中的LLM引导多模态融合。它通过将城市感知理论的原理嵌入到注意力机制中，将类人的空间推理与现代VPR架构连接起来。其即插即用设计、强大的跨源鲁棒性和可解释性突出了其潜力。
AI.translation: 来自社交媒体的众包街景图像为城市洪水和其他危机事件提供了实时视觉证据，但通常缺乏用于应急响应的可靠地理元数据。现有的图像地理定位方法，也称为视觉地点识别（VPR）模型，在应用于此类图像时，由于跨源场景中的视觉失真和域偏移，性能会大幅下降。本文提出了VPR-AttLLM，这是一个与模型无关的框架，它通过注意力引导的描述符增强，将大型语言模型（LLMs）的语义推理和地理知识整合到已建立的VPR流程中。通过利用LLMs来识别城市背景中具有位置信息意义的区域并抑制视觉噪声，VPR-AttLLM在无需模型重新训练或额外数据的情况下提高了检索性能。研究在扩展基准上进行了全面评估，包括富含真实社交媒体洪水图像的SF-XL、基于既定查询集的合成洪水场景和Mapillary照片，以及一个新的捕获形态差异城市景观的HK-URBAN数据集。将VPR-AttLLM与三种最先进的VPR模型——CosPlace、EigenPlaces和SALAD——集成，持续提高了召回性能，相对增益通常在1-3%之间，在最具挑战性的真实洪水图像上高达8%。除了检索准确性的可衡量增益外，本研究还建立了一种可泛化的范式，用于视觉检索系统中的LLM引导多模态融合。通过将城市感知理论的原理嵌入到注意力机制中，VPR-AttLLM将类人的空间推理与现代VPR架构连接起来。其即插即用设计、强大的跨源鲁棒性和可解释性突出了其在可扩展城市监测和众包危机图像快速地理定位方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VPR-AttLLM框架，旨在增强众包洪水图像的地理定位能力。该方法通过LLM引导的注意力机制来识别具有位置信息的区域并抑制视觉噪声，从而增强视觉地点识别（VPR）描述符。VPR-AttLLM是与模型无关的，无需重新训练即可集成到现有VPR流程中，并在最具挑战性的真实洪水图像上带来了显著的性能提升（高达8%），为城市监测提供了可扩展、可解释的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 地理定位, 众包洪水图像, LLM引导的注意力, 视觉地点识别, 多模态融合
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了VPR-AttLLM框架，利用LLM的语义推理和地理知识来指导VPR模型的视觉注意力，从而解决众包危机图像中常见的视觉失真和跨源域偏移问题。这种即插即用的、模型无关的LLM-VPR集成范式具有很高的通用性和实用性，它在不进行模型重训练的情况下实现了显著的性能提升，并为视觉检索系统中的多模态融合提供了一个可解释的桥梁。

title: Assessing Greenspace Attractiveness with ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini: Do AI Models Reflect Human Perceptions?
summary: Understanding greenspace attractiveness is essential for designing livable and inclusive urban environments, yet existing assessment approaches often overlook informal or transient spaces and remain too resource intensive to capture subjective perceptions at scale. This study examines the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), ChatGPT GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Haiku, and Gemini 2.0 Flash, to assess greenspace attractiveness similarly to humans using Google Street View imagery. We compared model outputs with responses from a geo-questionnaire of residents in Lodz, Poland, across both formal (for example, parks and managed greenspaces) and informal (for example, meadows and wastelands) greenspaces. Survey respondents and models indicated whether each greenspace was attractive or unattractive and provided up to three free text explanations. Analyses examined how often their attractiveness judgments aligned and compared their explanations after classifying them into shared reasoning categories. Results show high AI human agreement for attractive formal greenspaces and unattractive informal spaces, but low alignment for attractive informal and unattractive formal greenspaces. Models consistently emphasized aesthetic and design oriented features, underrepresenting safety, functional infrastructure, and locally embedded qualities valued by survey respondents. While these findings highlight the potential for scalable pre-assessment, they also underscore the need for human oversight and complementary participatory approaches. We conclude that MLLMs can support, but not replace, context sensitive greenspace evaluation in planning practice.

AI.title_translation: 使用ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini评估绿地吸引力：AI模型是否反映人类感知？
AI.tldr: 本研究比较了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与人类对绿地吸引力的感知。结果显示，AI在某些类型绿地上的评估与人类高度一致，但在另一些类型上存在差异，且过度强调美学，忽视了安全和本地价值。MLLMs可辅助规划，但不能替代人类评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的绿地吸引力评估方法忽略了非正式空间，且资源消耗大，难以大规模捕获主观感知。因此，研究旨在探究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能否像人类一样评估绿地吸引力。
AI.method: 使用Google街景图像，将多模态大语言模型（GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.0 Flash）的绿地吸引力评估结果，与波兰罗兹居民的地理问卷调查结果进行对比。分析了模型和人类在吸引力判断上的一致性，并对他们提供的自由文本解释进行了分类和比较，涵盖正式和非正式绿地。
AI.result: 结果显示，AI与人类在“有吸引力的正式绿地”和“无吸引力的非正式空间”上具有高度一致性，但在“有吸引力的非正式绿地”和“无吸引力的正式绿地”上一致性较低。模型持续强调美学和设计特征，而对受访者重视的安全、功能性基础设施和本地化特质的代表性不足。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs具备支持可扩展预评估的潜力，但需要人类监督和互补的参与式方法。它们可以支持，但不能取代规划实践中对背景敏感的绿地评估。
AI.translation: 了解绿地吸引力对于设计宜居和包容的城市环境至关重要，但现有的评估方法往往忽略非正式或短暂的空间，且资源消耗过大，难以大规模捕获主观感知。本研究检验了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs），即ChatGPT GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Haiku和Gemini 2.0 Flash，使用Google街景图像评估绿地吸引力与人类相似的能力。我们将模型输出结果与波兰罗兹居民的地理问卷调查结果进行了比较，涉及正式（例如，公园和管理绿地）和非正式（例如，草地和荒地）绿地。受访者和模型均指出每个绿地是吸引人还是不吸引人，并提供了最多三个自由文本解释。分析检验了它们的吸引力判断一致性频率，并在将解释归类为共享推理类别后进行了比较。结果显示，AI与人类在“有吸引力的正式绿地”和“无吸引力的非正式空间”上具有高度一致性，但在“有吸引力的非正式绿地”和“无吸引力的正式绿地”上一致性较低。模型持续强调美学和设计导向的特征，而对受访者重视的安全、功能性基础设施和本地化特质的代表性不足。尽管这些发现突显了可扩展预评估的潜力，但它们也强调了人类监督和互补参与式方法的必要性。我们总结认为，MLLMs可以支持，但不能取代规划实践中对背景敏感的绿地评估。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs，包括GPT-4o、Claude 3.5和Gemini 2.0）在使用Google街景图像评估绿地吸引力时，是否能反映人类的感知。研究将模型的判断结果与波兰罗兹居民的问卷调查结果进行对比，涵盖正式和非正式绿地。结果发现，AI在评估有吸引力的正式绿地和无吸引力的非正式空间时与人类高度一致，但在评估有吸引力的非正式空间和无吸引力的正式空间时一致性较低。此外，模型倾向于关注美学和设计，而忽略了人类重视的安全和本地化品质。研究认为，虽然MLLMs可用于大规模预评估，但它们只能辅助规划实践中的评估，不能完全替代人类的参与和对情境的敏感性。
AI.keywords: 绿地吸引力, 多模态大语言模型, 人类感知, 城市规划, Google街景
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将前沿的多模态大语言模型应用于城市规划中主观感知（绿地吸引力）的评估，并首次系统地比较了模型对正式和非正式绿地的判断差异。其重要性在于提供了一种可扩展的预评估工具，以解决传统方法资源密集的问题。然而，研究明确指出模型的局限性：AI过度依赖视觉美学特征，未能充分捕捉人类重视的安全、功能性和本地化情境等深层因素，强调了在城市规划应用中，AI辅助工具必须辅以必要的人类监督和实地/参与式评估。

title: On the Design of One-step Diffusion via Shortcutting Flow Paths
comments: 10 pages of main body, conference paper
summary: Recent advances in few-step diffusion models have demonstrated their efficiency and effectiveness by shortcutting the probabilistic paths of diffusion models, especially in training one-step diffusion models from scratch (\emph{a.k.a.} shortcut models). However, their theoretical derivation and practical implementation are often closely coupled, which obscures the design space. To address this, we propose a common design framework for representative shortcut models. This framework provides theoretical justification for their validity and disentangles concrete component-level choices, thereby enabling systematic identification of improvements. With our proposed improvements, the resulting one-step model achieves a new state-of-the-art FID50k of 2.85 on ImageNet-256x256 under the classifier-free guidance setting with one step generation, and further reaches FID50k of 2.52 with 2x training steps. Remarkably, the model requires no pre-training, distillation, or curriculum learning. We believe our work lowers the barrier to component-level innovation in shortcut models and facilitates principled exploration of their design space.
comment: 10 pages of main body, conference paper

AI.title_translation: 关于通过捷径流路径设计一步扩散模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种通用设计框架，用于解耦和改进一步扩散模型。由此产生的模型在ImageNet-256x256上实现了新的单步生成SOTA FID（2.85），且无需预训练或蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有的一步扩散模型（捷径模型）的理论推导和实际实现紧密耦合，限制了设计空间的探索和改进。
AI.method: 提出了一个代表性捷径模型的通用设计框架。该框架为模型的有效性提供了理论依据，并解耦了具体的组件级选择。
AI.result: 改进后的一步模型在ImageNet-256x256上实现了新的单步生成SOTA FID50k 2.85（在分类器自由指导设置下），在使用2倍训练步数时达到2.52。该模型无需预训练、蒸馏或课程学习。
AI.conclusion: 该工作降低了捷径模型中组件级创新的障碍，并有助于对设计空间进行系统性探索。
AI.translation: 最近的少步扩散模型通过捷径化扩散模型的概率路径，展示了其效率和有效性，尤其是在从头开始训练一步扩散模型（又称捷径模型）方面。然而，它们的理论推导和实际实现往往紧密耦合，模糊了设计空间。为解决此问题，我们提出了一个用于代表性捷径模型的通用设计框架。该框架为模型的有效性提供了理论依据，并解耦了具体的组件级选择，从而能够系统地识别改进点。通过我们提出的改进，由此产生的一步模型在ImageNet-256x256上，在分类器自由指导设置下，实现了新的单步生成SOTA FID50k 2.85，并在使用2倍训练步数时进一步达到FID50k 2.52。值得注意的是，该模型不需要预训练、蒸馏或课程学习。我们相信我们的工作降低了捷径模型中组件级创新的障碍，并促进了对其设计空间的系统探索。
AI.summary: 本文针对一步扩散模型中理论与实现紧密耦合的问题，提出了一个通用设计框架。该框架为模型有效性提供理论依据，并解耦组件级选择，从而实现系统化改进。基于此框架的改进模型在ImageNet-256x256上实现了单步生成新的SOTA FID 2.85，且无需预训练。
AI.keywords: 一步扩散模型, 捷径模型, 设计框架, FID, 图像生成
AI.comments: 本文的核心创新在于提出了一个通用的设计框架，成功地将一步扩散模型（捷径模型）的理论基础与实际组件选择解耦。这种方法降低了模型改进的门槛，使得研究人员可以系统地探索设计空间。在实践中，该框架指导的模型在ImageNet-256x256上实现了新的SOTA FID（2.85），且无需依赖预训练或蒸馏等常见技术，证明了其在效率和性能上的重要性。

title: Love First, Know Later: Persona-Based Romantic Compatibility Through LLM Text World Engines
comments: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop: First Workshop on LLM Persona Modeling (Oral)
summary: We propose Love First, Know Later: a paradigm shift in computational matching that simulates interactions first, then assesses compatibility. Instead of comparing static profiles, our framework leverages LLMs as text world engines that operate in dual capacity-as persona-driven agents following behavioral policies and as the environment modeling interaction dynamics. We formalize compatibility assessment as a reward-modeling problem: given observed matching outcomes, we learn to extract signals from simulations that predict human preferences. Our key insight is that relationships hinge on responses to critical moments-we translate this observation from relationship psychology into mathematical hypotheses, enabling effective simulation. Theoretically, we prove that as LLM policies better approximate human behavior, the induced matching converges to optimal stable matching. Empirically, we validate on speed dating data for initial chemistry and divorce prediction for long-term stability. This paradigm enables interactive, personalized matching systems where users iteratively refine their agents, unlocking future possibilities for transparent and interactive compatibility assessment.
comment: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop: First Workshop on LLM Persona Modeling (Oral)

AI.title_translation: 先爱后知：基于角色的浪漫兼容性通过LLM文本世界引擎
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为“先爱后知”的浪漫匹配新范式，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为文本世界引擎来模拟基于角色的互动。通过将兼容性评估形式化为奖励建模问题，并基于关系心理学中的“关键时刻”洞察，该方法能够预测人类偏好，并在理论上证明了其收敛性，并在速配和离婚预测数据上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 提出一种计算匹配的范式转变，即“先爱后知”，旨在通过模拟互动而非比较静态个人资料来评估浪漫兼容性。
AI.method: 1. 利用LLMs作为文本世界引擎，同时充当遵循行为策略的角色驱动代理和模拟互动动态的环境。 2. 将兼容性评估形式化为奖励建模问题，从模拟中提取信号来预测人类偏好。 3. 将关系心理学中关于“关键时刻”的洞察转化为数学假设，以实现有效的模拟。
AI.result: 1. 理论上证明，随着LLM策略更好地近似人类行为，由此产生的匹配收敛于最优稳定匹配。 2. 经验上，该方法在速配数据上验证了初始化学反应的预测，并在离婚预测数据上验证了长期稳定性。
AI.conclusion: “先爱后知”范式实现了交互式、个性化的匹配系统，用户可以迭代地改进其代理，为透明和交互式的兼容性评估开辟了未来可能性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了“先爱后知”：一种计算匹配的范式转变，它首先模拟互动，然后评估兼容性。我们的框架没有比较静态的个人资料，而是利用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为文本世界引擎，以双重身份运作——作为遵循行为策略的角色驱动代理，以及作为建模互动动态的环境。我们将兼容性评估形式化为一个奖励建模问题：给定观察到的匹配结果，我们学习从模拟中提取信号来预测人类偏好。我们的关键洞察是，关系取决于对关键时刻的反应——我们将这一关系心理学的观察转化为数学假设，从而实现有效的模拟。理论上，我们证明了随着LLM策略更好地近似人类行为，由此产生的匹配收敛于最优稳定匹配。在经验上，我们在速配数据上验证了初始化学反应，并在离婚预测数据上验证了长期稳定性。这种范式实现了交互式、个性化的匹配系统，用户可以迭代地完善他们的代理，为透明和交互式的兼容性评估解锁了未来的可能性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“先爱后知”的浪漫兼容性评估新范式，该范式利用大型语言模型（LLMs）充当文本世界引擎，模拟基于角色的互动过程。该方法将兼容性评估构建为奖励建模任务，并基于关系心理学中“关键时刻”的洞察进行建模。研究证明了该匹配过程在理论上能收敛至最优稳定匹配，并在实际中通过预测速配中的初始化学反应和长期的离婚风险来验证其有效性。
AI.keywords: 浪漫兼容性, LLM文本世界引擎, 奖励建模, 角色驱动代理, 模拟匹配
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于将LLMs从简单的文本生成工具提升为复杂的“文本世界引擎”，用于模拟社会互动和关系动力学，从而解决了传统匹配系统依赖静态数据、缺乏动态交互评估的问题。将兼容性评估转化为奖励建模问题，并结合关系心理学中的“关键时刻”理论，使模拟更具现实意义和预测能力。其理论证明和在长期稳定性预测上的应用潜力，标志着计算社会学和个性化推荐领域的一个重要进步。

title: The Memecoin Phenomenon: An In-Depth Study of Solana's Blockchain Trends
summary: This paper analyzes the emerging memecoin phenomenon on the Solana blockchain, focusing on the Pump$.$fun platform during Q4 2024. Using on-chain data, it is explored how retail-focused token creation platforms are reshaping blockchain ecosystems and influencing market participation. This study finds that Pump$.$fun accounted for up to 71.1% of all tokens minted on Solana and contributed 40-67.4% of total DEX transactions. Despite this activity, fewer than 2% of tokens successfully transitioned to major decentralized exchanges, highlighting a highly speculative market structure. The platform experienced rapid growth, with daily active users rising from 60,000 to peaks of 260,000, underscoring strong retail adoption. This reflects a broader shift towards accessible, socially-driven market participation enabled by memecoins. However, while memecoins lower entry barriers and encourage retail engagement, they introduce significant risks. The volatile and speculative nature of these platforms raises concerns about long-term sustainability and the resilience of the blockchain ecosystem. These findings reveal the dual impact of memecoins: they democratize token creation and alter market dynamics but may jeopardize market efficiency and stability. This paper highlights the need to critically assess the implications of retail-driven speculative trading and its potential to disrupt emerging blockchain economies.

AI.title_translation: Memecoin现象：对Solana区块链趋势的深入研究
AI.tldr: 本文深入研究了2024年第四季度Solana区块链上的迷因币（memecoin）现象，重点关注Pump$.$fun平台。研究发现，该平台贡献了Solana上大部分的新代币铸造（高达71.1%）和DEX交易，吸引了大量散户参与，但市场高度投机（不到2%的代币成功上架）。迷因币虽然降低了参与门槛，但也带来了重大的市场稳定性和效率风险。
AI.motivation: 旨在分析以散户为中心的代币创建平台（如Pump$.$fun）如何重塑区块链生态系统并影响市场参与度。
AI.method: 使用链上数据（on-chain data）进行分析。
AI.result: Pump$.$fun平台占Solana上铸造代币总量的71.1%，占DEX总交易量的40%至67.4%。尽管活动频繁，但成功过渡到主要去中心化交易所的代币不到2%，表明市场结构高度投机。日活跃用户从60,000激增至峰值260,000。
AI.conclusion: 迷因币具有双重影响：它们使代币创建民主化并改变了市场动态，但也可能危及市场效率和稳定性。研究强调需要批判性地评估散户驱动的投机交易的影响及其扰乱新兴区块链经济的潜力。
AI.translation: 本文分析了Solana区块链上新兴的迷因币（memecoin）现象，重点关注2024年第四季度期间的Pump$.$fun平台。研究利用链上数据，探讨了以散户为中心的代币创建平台如何重塑区块链生态系统并影响市场参与度。研究发现，Pump$.$fun平台占Solana上所有铸造代币的71.1%，并贡献了DEX总交易量的40%至67.4%。尽管活动频繁，但成功过渡到主要去中心化交易所的代币不到2%，突显出一种高度投机的市场结构。该平台经历了快速增长，日活跃用户从60,000人增加到峰值260,000人，突显了强劲的散户采用率。这反映了迷因币所促成的、向可访问的、社交驱动的市场参与的更广泛转变。然而，虽然迷因币降低了进入门槛并鼓励了散户参与，但它们也带来了重大风险。这些平台的波动性和投机性质引发了对长期可持续性以及区块链生态系统弹性的担忧。这些发现揭示了迷因币的双重影响：它们使代币创建民主化并改变了市场动态，但可能危及市场效率和稳定性。本文强调需要批判性地评估散户驱动的投机交易的影响及其扰乱新兴区块链经济的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究深入分析了2024年第四季度Solana区块链上的迷因币热潮，特别是Pump$.$fun平台。通过链上数据分析，论文揭示了此类散户平台如何主导代币铸造（高达71.1%）和DEX交易（40%-67.4%），并吸引了大量新用户。尽管用户增长强劲，市场本质上却高度投机（不到2%的代币成功上架）。研究指出，迷因币虽然促进了市场民主化和散户参与，但也带来了显著的波动性和风险，可能损害区块链生态系统的长期稳定性和效率。
AI.keywords: 迷因币, Solana, Pump$.$fun, 链上数据, 散户投机
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于量化了像Pump$.$fun这样面向散户的代币创建平台对主流区块链生态（Solana）的巨大影响。数据极其具体，例如71.1%的铸币占比和40%-67.4%的DEX交易占比，有力地证明了迷因币已成为Solana生态系统的主要驱动力。其重要性在于，它不仅确认了迷因币的零售采用趋势，更提出了关于市场稳定性和效率的严肃质疑，揭示了该现象的“双刃剑”效应。局限性可能在于数据仅限于2024年第四季度，且高度依赖单个平台（Pump$.$fun），可能无法完全概括整个迷因币市场的长期动态。

title: Using Socio-economic Indicators, Smart Transit Systems, and Urban Simulator to Accelerate ZEV Adoption and Reduce VMT
summary: Globally, on-road transportation accounts for 15% of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and an estimated 385,000 premature deaths from PM2.5. Cities play a critical role in meeting IPCC targets, generating 75% of global energy-related GHG emissions. In Houston, Texas, on-road transportation represents 48% of baseline emissions in the Climate Action Plan (CAP). To reach net-zero by 2050, the CAP targets a 70% emissions reduction from a 2014 baseline, offset by 30% renewable energy. This goal is challenging because Houston is low-density and auto-dependent, with 89% of on-road emissions from cars and small trucks and limited public transit usage. Socio-economic disparities further constrain Zero Emissions Vehicle (ZEV) adoption. Strategies focus on expanding ZEV access and reducing Vehicle Miles Traveled (VMT) by 20% through transit improvements and city design. This paper presents methods for establishing an on-road emissions baseline and evaluating policies that leverage socio-economic indicators and Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) to accelerate ZEV adoption and reduce VMT. Smart parking, transit incentives, secure data systems, and ZEV fleet management support improvements in modal split and system reliability. Policy options are analyzed and potential actions identified. To support evaluation, a simulation environment was developed in Unity 3D, enabling dynamic modeling of urban mobility and visualization of policy scenarios. Auto-dependent cities aiming for 2050 emission targets can benefit from the indicators, metrics, and technologies discussed.

AI.title_translation: 利用社会经济指标、智能交通系统和城市模拟器加速零排放汽车普及并减少车辆行驶里程
AI.tldr: 针对休斯顿等汽车依赖型城市，本文提出了一套利用社会经济指标和智能交通系统来加速零排放汽车（ZEV）普及、减少车辆行驶里程（VMT）的政策评估方法，并开发了基于Unity 3D的城市模拟环境以支持动态建模和可视化。
AI.motivation: 全球道路交通是温室气体排放和PM2.5致死的主要来源。休斯顿作为汽车依赖型低密度城市，其道路交通占基线排放的48%。为实现2050年净零排放目标（需减排70%），城市必须克服汽车依赖和现有的社会经济差异对零排放汽车（ZEV）普及的限制。
AI.method: 提出了建立道路排放基线和评估政策的方法。这些政策利用社会经济指标和智能交通系统（ITS）来加速ZEV普及并减少VMT。具体措施包括智能停车、交通激励、安全数据系统和ZEV车队管理。同时，开发了一个基于Unity 3D的城市模拟环境，用于城市流动性的动态建模和政策情景的可视化。
AI.result: 对政策选项进行了分析并确定了潜在的行动方案。开发了动态模拟环境。
AI.conclusion: 旨在实现2050年排放目标的汽车依赖型城市，可以从本文讨论的指标、衡量标准和技术中受益。
AI.translation: 在全球范围内，道路交通占温室气体（GHG）排放的15%，并估计造成385,000例PM2.5导致的过早死亡。城市在实现IPCC目标方面发挥着关键作用，产生了全球75%的能源相关温室气体排放。在德克萨斯州休斯顿，道路交通占《气候行动计划》（CAP）基线排放的48%。为实现2050年净零排放目标，CAP要求在2014年基线基础上减排70%，并辅以30%的可再生能源抵消。由于休斯顿是低密度和汽车依赖型城市，89%的道路排放来自汽车和小型卡车，且公共交通使用有限，这一目标极具挑战性。社会经济差异进一步限制了零排放汽车（ZEV）的普及。策略重点是通过改善交通和城市设计，扩大ZEV的可及性并将车辆行驶里程（VMT）减少20%。本文提出了建立道路排放基线和评估利用社会经济指标及智能交通系统（ITS）加速ZEV普及和减少VMT的政策的方法。智能停车、交通激励、安全数据系统和ZEV车队管理支持模式划分和系统可靠性的改进。论文分析了政策选项并确定了潜在的行动。为支持评估，开发了一个基于Unity 3D的模拟环境，能够对城市流动性进行动态建模和政策情景的可视化。旨在实现2050年排放目标的汽车依赖型城市可以从所讨论的指标、衡量标准和技术中受益。
AI.summary: 本文针对休斯顿等高度依赖汽车的城市如何实现其雄心勃勃的净零排放目标（到2050年减排70%）的问题。提出了一套结合社会经济指标和智能交通系统（ITS）的政策评估方法，旨在加速零排放汽车（ZEV）的普及并实现20%的车辆行驶里程（VMT）减少目标。通过分析智能停车、交通激励和ZEV车队管理等政策选项，并利用基于Unity 3D开发的城市模拟环境进行动态建模和可视化，为汽车依赖型城市实现减排目标提供了可借鉴的指标、技术和策略。
AI.keywords: 零排放汽车（ZEV）普及, 车辆行驶里程（VMT）减少, 智能交通系统（ITS）, 社会经济指标, 城市模拟器
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将复杂的城市规划和气候行动目标与先进的ITS技术、社会经济公平性考量以及动态的城市模拟器（Unity 3D）结合起来。对于休斯顿这类低密度、高度汽车依赖且存在社会经济差异的城市而言，传统的减排策略往往效果不佳。该研究通过提供一个综合性的框架，特别关注ZEV普及的社会经济障碍和VMT减少的结构性挑战，为全球其他面临类似挑战的城市提供了实用的工具和可复制的评估方法。其局限性在于抽象中未提供实际的政策评估结果或模拟验证数据。

title: Semantic-Drive: Democratizing Long-Tail Data Curation via Open-Vocabulary Grounding and Neuro-Symbolic VLM Consensus
summary: The development of robust Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of "Long-Tail" training data. While fleets collect petabytes of video logs, identifying rare safety-critical events (e.g., erratic jaywalking, construction diversions) remains a manual, cost-prohibitive process. Existing solutions rely on coarse metadata search, which lacks precision, or cloud-based VLMs, which are privacy-invasive and expensive. We introduce Semantic-Drive, a local-first, neuro-symbolic framework for semantic data mining. Our approach decouples perception into two stages: (1) Symbolic Grounding via a real-time open-vocabulary detector (YOLOE) to anchor attention, and (2) Cognitive Analysis via a Reasoning VLM that performs forensic scene analysis. To mitigate hallucination, we implement a "System 2" inference-time alignment strategy, utilizing a multi-model "Judge-Scout" consensus mechanism. Benchmarked on the nuScenes dataset against the Waymo Open Dataset (WOD-E2E) taxonomy, Semantic-Drive achieves a Recall of 0.966 (vs. 0.475 for CLIP) and reduces Risk Assessment Error by 40% ccompared to the best single scout models. The system runs entirely on consumer hardware (NVIDIA RTX 3090), offering a privacy-preserving alternative to the cloud.

AI.title_translation: Semantic-Drive：通过开放词汇的定位和神经符号VLM共识实现长尾数据策展的民主化
AI.tldr: 针对自动驾驶汽车长尾数据稀缺问题，本文提出了Semantic-Drive框架。它在本地使用神经符号方法（YOLOE+推理VLM）和多模型共识机制来高效、精确地识别罕见的安全事件，性能远超CLIP，且保护隐私。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒的自动驾驶汽车（AVs）的发展受到“长尾”训练数据稀缺的限制。识别罕见的安全关键事件（如不规范的乱穿马路、施工改道）是人工的、成本高昂的过程。现有解决方案（粗糙元数据搜索或基于云的VLM）缺乏精度、侵犯隐私或价格昂贵。
AI.method: 提出了一个本地优先的神经符号框架Semantic-Drive，用于语义数据挖掘。该方法将感知解耦为两个阶段：（1）通过实时开放词汇检测器（YOLOE）进行符号定位，以锚定注意力；（2）通过推理VLM进行认知分析，执行现场取证分析。为减轻幻觉，采用了“系统2”推理时对齐策略，利用多模型“裁判-侦察兵”（Judge-Scout）共识机制。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上，针对Waymo开放数据集（WOD-E2E）分类法进行基准测试，Semantic-Drive的召回率达到0.966（相比CLIP的0.475），并将风险评估错误减少了40%。该系统完全在消费级硬件（NVIDIA RTX 3090）上运行。
AI.conclusion: Semantic-Drive提供了一种保护隐私的本地替代方案，解决了云端解决方案的弊端，通过高效地策展长尾数据，实现了自动驾驶数据策展的民主化。
AI.translation: 鲁棒的自动驾驶汽车（AVs）的发展受到“长尾”训练数据稀缺的限制。尽管车队收集了数PB的视频日志，但识别罕见的安全关键事件（例如，不规范的乱穿马路、施工改道）仍然是一个人工的、成本高昂的过程。现有解决方案依赖于缺乏精度的粗糙元数据搜索，或者依赖于侵犯隐私且昂贵的基于云的VLM。我们引入了Semantic-Drive，这是一个本地优先的神经符号框架，用于语义数据挖掘。我们的方法将感知解耦为两个阶段：（1）通过实时开放词汇检测器（YOLOE）进行符号定位，以锚定注意力；（2）通过推理VLM进行认知分析，执行现场取证分析。为了减轻幻觉，我们实施了“系统2”推理时对齐策略，利用多模型“裁判-侦察兵”共识机制。在nuScenes数据集上，针对Waymo开放数据集（WOD-E2E）分类法进行基准测试，Semantic-Drive的召回率达到0.966（相比CLIP的0.475），并将风险评估错误减少了40%。该系统完全在消费级硬件（NVIDIA RTX 3090）上运行，提供了对云服务的隐私保护替代方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Semantic-Drive，一个本地优先的神经符号框架，旨在解决自动驾驶汽车训练中长尾数据稀缺的问题。该框架通过结合开放词汇检测器（YOLOE）进行符号定位和推理视觉语言模型（VLM）进行认知分析，实现了语义数据挖掘。为了提高可靠性，它采用多模型“裁判-侦察兵”共识机制来减轻VLM的幻觉。实验证明，Semantic-Drive在长尾事件识别的召回率上显著优于CLIP，并降低了风险评估错误，同时能在消费级硬件上运行，提供了一种保护隐私且高效的数据策展解决方案。
AI.keywords: 长尾数据策展, 神经符号系统, 开放词汇定位, VLM共识, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将神经（VLM）和符号（YOLOE定位）方法结合，形成一个“本地优先”的框架，高效地解决了自动驾驶领域中长期存在的长尾数据标注难题。特别值得注意的是，其引入的多模型“裁判-侦察兵”共识机制，类似于人类的“系统2”思维，有效缓解了VLM的固有缺陷（幻觉），显著提高了识别精度（召回率高达0.966）。此外，该系统能够在消费级硬件上运行，打破了对昂贵云服务的依赖，对于推动自动驾驶数据策展的民主化具有重要的实践意义。

title: The Instability of Safety: How Random Seeds and Temperature Expose Inconsistent LLM Refusal Behavior
comments: 16 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/erikl2/safety-refusal-stability
summary: Current safety evaluations of large language models rely on single-shot testing, implicitly assuming that model responses are deterministic and representative of the model's safety alignment. We challenge this assumption by investigating the stability of safety refusal decisions across random seeds and temperature settings. Testing four instruction-tuned models from three families (Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B, Qwen 3 8B, Gemma 3 12B) on 876 harmful prompts across 20 different sampling configurations (4 temperatures x 5 random seeds), we find that 18-28% of prompts exhibit decision flips--the model refuses in some configurations but complies in others--depending on the model. Our Safety Stability Index (SSI) reveals that higher temperatures significantly reduce decision stability (Friedman chi-squared = 396.81, p < 0.001), with mean within-temperature SSI dropping from 0.977 at temperature 0.0 to 0.942 at temperature 1.0. We validate our findings across all model families using Claude 3.5 Haiku as a unified external judge, achieving 89.0% inter-judge agreement with our primary Llama 70B judge (Cohen's kappa = 0.62). Within each model, prompts with higher compliance rates exhibit lower stability (Spearman rho = -0.47 to -0.70, all p < 0.001), indicating that models "waver" more on borderline requests. These findings demonstrate that single-shot safety evaluations are insufficient for reliable safety assessment and that evaluation protocols must account for stochastic variation in model behavior. We show that single-shot evaluation agrees with multi-sample ground truth only 92.4% of the time when pooling across temperatures (94.2-97.7% at fixed temperature depending on setting), and recommend using at least 3 samples per prompt for reliable safety assessment.
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/erikl2/safety-refusal-stability

AI.title_translation: 安全性的不稳定性：随机种子和温度如何揭示LLM拒绝行为的不一致性
AI.tldr: 当前LLM安全评估依赖单次测试，但本研究发现，随机种子和温度设置会导致LLM的安全拒绝行为高度不稳定。18-28%的有害提示会出现拒绝/服从的决策翻转，尤其是在高温度和临界请求上。因此，单次评估不足以保证可靠性，建议每个提示至少使用3个样本进行评估。
AI.motivation: 挑战当前大型语言模型（LLM）安全评估中隐含的假设，即模型响应是确定性的且代表其安全对齐。研究随机种子和温度设置下安全拒绝决策的稳定性。
AI.method: 测试了来自三个家族的四种指令调优模型（Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B, Qwen 3 8B, Gemma 3 12B）。使用876个有害提示，在20种不同的采样配置（4个温度 x 5个随机种子）下进行测试。使用安全稳定性指数（SSI）量化稳定性，并使用Claude 3.5 Haiku作为外部裁判进行验证。
AI.result: 18%到28%的提示表现出决策翻转（在某些配置下拒绝，在其他配置下服从）。更高的温度显著降低了决策稳定性（平均SSI从温度0.0时的0.977降至1.0时的0.942）。顺从率越高的提示，稳定性越低（Spearman rho = -0.47至-0.70），表明模型在临界请求上“犹豫”。单次评估与多样本真实值的一致性仅为92.4%（跨温度池化时）。
AI.conclusion: 单次安全评估不足以进行可靠的安全评估，评估协议必须考虑模型行为中的随机变化。建议每个提示至少使用3个样本来进行可靠的安全评估。
AI.translation: 当前对大型语言模型（LLM）的安全评估依赖于单次测试，隐含地假设模型响应是确定性的，并且代表了模型的安全对齐。我们通过调查跨随机种子和温度设置的安全拒绝决策的稳定性来挑战这一假设。我们测试了来自三个家族的四种指令调优模型（Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 7B、Qwen 3 8B、Gemma 3 12B），在20种不同的采样配置（4个温度 x 5个随机种子）下，对876个有害提示进行了测试。我们发现，根据模型的不同，18%到28%的提示表现出决策翻转——模型在某些配置下拒绝，但在其他配置下服从。我们的安全稳定性指数（SSI）显示，更高的温度显著降低了决策稳定性（Friedman卡方 = 396.81，p < 0.001），平均温度内SSI从温度0.0时的0.977降至温度1.0时的0.942。我们使用Claude 3.5 Haiku作为统一的外部裁判，在所有模型家族中验证了我们的发现，与我们的主要Llama 70B裁判达到了89.0%的裁判间一致性（Cohen's kappa = 0.62）。在每个模型内部，顺从率较高的提示表现出较低的稳定性（Spearman rho = -0.47至-0.70，所有p < 0.001），这表明模型在临界请求上“犹豫”更多。这些发现表明，单次安全评估不足以进行可靠的安全评估，并且评估协议必须考虑到模型行为中的随机变化。我们展示了当跨温度池化时，单次评估与多样本真实值的一致性仅为92.4%（在固定温度下，根据设置不同为94.2%至97.7%），并建议每个提示至少使用3个样本来进行可靠的安全评估。
AI.summary: 本文挑战了LLM安全评估中响应确定性的假设，通过在不同随机种子和温度设置下测试四种指令调优模型对876个有害提示的安全拒绝稳定性。研究发现，18%-28%的提示存在拒绝/服从的决策翻转，且温度越高，稳定性显著降低。模型在顺从率较高的临界请求上表现出更大的“犹豫”。结果表明，单次安全评估是不可靠的，因为它与多样本真实值的一致性较低。作者建议在安全评估协议中必须考虑随机变化，并推荐每个提示至少使用3个样本以确保可靠性。
AI.keywords: LLM安全评估, 随机种子, 温度, 拒绝行为, 稳定性, 单次测试
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于系统地揭示了LLM安全对齐行为的内在不稳定性，特别是量化了随机性和温度对安全拒绝决策的影响。它直接挑战了行业内普遍依赖的“单次测试”评估范式，提出了一个关键的限制：即便是高度对齐的模型，其安全边界在采样参数变化时也可能是模糊和不一致的。这对于未来设计更鲁棒、更可靠的LLM安全评估框架至关重要。研究结果中关于“临界请求”稳定性最低的发现，为理解模型安全边界的脆弱性提供了深刻见解。

title: Verification of Lightning Network Channel Balances with Trusted Execution Environments (TEE)
summary: Verifying the private liquidity state of Lightning Network (LN) channels is desirable for auditors, service providers, and network participants who need assurance of financial capacity. Current methods often lack robustness against a malicious or compromised node operator. This paper introduces a methodology for the verification of LN channel balances. The core contribution is a framework that combines Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) with Zero-Knowledge Transport Layer Security (zkTLS) to provide strong, hardware-backed guarantees. In our proposed method, the node's balance-reporting software runs within a TEE, which generates a remote attestation quote proving the software's integrity. This attestation is then served via an Application Programming Interface (API), and zkTLS is used to prove the authenticity of its delivery. We also analyze an alternative variant where the TEE signs the report directly without zkTLS, discussing the trade-offs between transport-layer verification and direct enclave signing. We further refine this by distinguishing between "Hot Proofs"(verifiable claims via TEEs) and "Cold Proofs" (on-chain settlement), and discuss critical security considerations including hardware vulnerabilities, privacy leakage to third-party APIs, and the performance overhead of enclaved operations.

AI.title_translation: 使用可信执行环境（TEE）验证闪电网络通道余额
AI.tldr: 使用可信执行环境（TEE）和零知识传输层安全（zkTLS）框架，为闪电网络通道余额验证提供强大的、硬件支持的保证，以对抗恶意节点操作员。
AI.motivation: 审计员、服务提供商和网络参与者需要确保闪电网络（LN）通道的财务能力，但现有方法缺乏针对恶意或受损节点操作员的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出一个结合可信执行环境（TEE）和零知识传输层安全（zkTLS）的框架。节点余额报告软件在TEE内运行，生成远程证明引用以证明软件完整性。该证明通过API提供，并使用zkTLS验证交付的真实性。文章还分析了TEE直接签名报告的替代方案，并区分了“热证明”（通过TEE）和“冷证明”（链上结算）。
AI.translation: 对于需要财务能力保证的审计员、服务提供商和网络参与者来说，验证闪电网络（LN）通道的私有流动性状态是可取的。目前的现有方法往往缺乏针对恶意或受损节点操作员的鲁棒性。本文介绍了一种验证LN通道余额的方法。核心贡献是一个结合了可信执行环境（TEE）和零知识传输层安全（zkTLS）的框架，以提供强大的、硬件支持的保证。在我们提出的方法中，节点的余额报告软件在TEE内运行，生成一个远程证明引用，证明软件的完整性。然后通过应用编程接口（API）提供该证明，并使用zkTLS来证明其交付的真实性。我们还分析了一个替代变体，即TEE直接签署报告而无需zkTLS，并讨论了传输层验证与直接飞地签名之间的权衡。我们通过区分“热证明”（通过TEE的可验证声明）和“冷证明”（链上结算）进一步完善了这一点，并讨论了关键的安全考虑因素，包括硬件漏洞、对第三方API的隐私泄露以及飞地操作的性能开销。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种使用可信执行环境（TEE）和零知识传输层安全（zkTLS）来验证闪电网络（LN）通道私有流动性状态的方法。通过在TEE内运行余额报告软件并生成远程证明引用，结合zkTLS确保交付真实性，为审计员和服务提供商提供硬件支持的财务能力保证。论文还分析了直接签名等替代方案，并讨论了硬件漏洞、隐私泄露和性能开销等关键安全问题。
AI.keywords: 闪电网络, 可信执行环境, 零知识传输层安全, 通道余额, 远程证明
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将可信执行环境（TEE）的硬件级完整性证明与零知识传输层安全（zkTLS）相结合，为闪电网络（LN）的链下私有流动性状态提供强大的、抗恶意节点的验证机制。这解决了LN生态系统中长期存在的信任和审计难题。文章不仅提出了解决方案，还深入分析了关键的安全考量和潜在限制，如硬件漏洞、第三方API的隐私风险和飞地操作的性能开销，这体现了对实际部署挑战的全面认识。

title: Audio-Visual Camera Pose Estimation with Passive Scene Sounds and In-the-Wild Video
summary: Understanding camera motion is a fundamental problem in embodied perception and 3D scene understanding. While visual methods have advanced rapidly, they often struggle under visually degraded conditions such as motion blur or occlusions. In this work, we show that passive scene sounds provide complementary cues for relative camera pose estimation for in-the-wild videos. We introduce a simple but effective audio-visual framework that integrates direction-ofarrival (DOA) spectra and binauralized embeddings into a state-of-the-art vision-only pose estimation model. Our results on two large datasets show consistent gains over strong visual baselines, plus robustness when the visual information is corrupted. To our knowledge, this represents the first work to successfully leverage audio for relative camera pose estimation in real-world videos, and it establishes incidental, everyday audio as an unexpected but promising signal for a classic spatial challenge. Project: http://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/av_camera_pose.

AI.title_translation: 基于被动场景声音和真实世界视频的视听相机姿态估计
AI.tldr: 传统的视觉相机姿态估计在视觉条件差时效果不佳。本文引入了一个视听框架，利用被动场景声音（通过DOA和双耳嵌入）作为补充线索，提高了在真实世界视频中相对相机姿态估计的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 相机运动理解是具身感知和3D场景理解的基础问题。现有的视觉方法在运动模糊或遮挡等视觉退化条件下表现不佳。因此，需要寻找互补的线索来提高鲁棒性。
AI.method: 引入了一个简单但有效的视听框架。该框架将到达方向（DOA）谱和双耳嵌入整合到一个最先进的纯视觉姿态估计算法中。
AI.result: 在两个大型数据集上的结果显示，该方法比强大的纯视觉基线具有持续的提升，并且在视觉信息受损时表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次成功利用音频进行真实世界视频中相对相机姿态估计的工作，证明了偶然的、日常的声音对于经典的定位挑战是一个意外但有前景的信号。
AI.translation: 理解相机运动是具身感知和3D场景理解中的一个基础问题。虽然视觉方法发展迅速，但它们在运动模糊或遮挡等视觉退化条件下往往会遇到困难。在这项工作中，我们展示了被动场景声音为真实世界视频中的相对相机姿态估计提供了互补线索。我们引入了一个简单但有效的视听框架，将到达方向（DOA）谱和双耳嵌入整合到最先进的纯视觉姿态估计模型中。我们在两个大型数据集上的结果显示，该方法比强大的纯视觉基线具有持续的提升，并且在视觉信息受损时表现出鲁棒性。据我们所知，这是第一项成功利用音频进行真实世界视频中相对相机姿态估计的工作，它将偶然的、日常的声音确立为解决经典空间挑战的一个意想不到但有前景的信号。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的视听框架，用于解决在视觉条件受损时（如模糊或遮挡）传统视觉相机姿态估计的局限性。该方法利用被动场景声音作为关键的补充线索，通过整合到达方向（DOA）谱和双耳嵌入到一个现有的视觉模型中，实现了相对相机姿态的估计。实验证明，该框架在两个大型数据集上不仅持续优于强大的纯视觉基线，而且在视觉信息损坏时表现出更高的鲁棒性。这项工作首次成功地在真实世界视频中利用音频进行相机姿态估计，为空间感知挑战开辟了新的信号来源。
AI.keywords: 视听相机姿态估计, 被动场景声音, 到达方向, 具身感知, 真实世界视频
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新性在于首次成功地将日常的、被动的场景声音引入到相对相机姿态估计这一经典的3D空间感知问题中，特别是在“真实世界视频”（in-the-wild video）的复杂背景下。它解决了纯视觉方法在视觉退化条件下的核心痛点，通过结合听觉线索显著提高了模型的鲁棒性和准确性。这项研究证明了声音作为一种互补的空间信号的巨大潜力，尤其对于具身感知和需要全方位感知的应用具有重要意义。

title: Reputation-Based Leader Election under Partial Synchrony: Towards a Protocol-Independent Abstraction with Enhanced Guarantees
summary: Leader election serves a well-defined role in leader-based Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) protocols. Existing reputation-based leader election frameworks for partially synchronous BFTs suffer from either protocol-specific proofs, narrow applicability, or unbounded recovery after network stabilization, leaving an open problem. This paper presents a novel protocol-independent abstraction formalizing generic correctness properties and effectiveness guarantees for leader election under partial synchrony, enabling protocol-independent analysis and design. Building on this, we design the Sliding Window Leader Election (SWLE) mechanism. SWLE dynamically adjusts leader nominations via consensus-behavior-based reputation scores, enforcing Byzantine-cost amplification. We demonstrate SWLE introduces minimal extra overhead to the base protocol and prove it satisfies all abstraction properties and provides superior effectiveness. We show, with a 16-server deployment across 4 different regions in northern China, SWLE achieves up to 4.2x higher throughput, 75% lower latency and 27% Byzantine leader frequency compared to the state-of-the-art solution under common Byzantine faults, while maintaining efficiency in fault-free scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 基于声誉的部分同步下的领导者选举：迈向具有增强保证的协议无关抽象
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个协议无关的抽象模型来形式化部分同步下领导者选举的正确性和有效性。基于此，设计了滑动窗口领导者选举（SWLE）机制，通过声誉评分动态调整选举。实验证明SWLE在拜占庭故障下能显著提高吞吐量（高达4.2倍）并降低延迟和恶意领导者频率，同时保持了高效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的部分同步拜占庭容错（BFT）协议中的基于声誉的领导者选举框架存在协议特定证明、适用性狭窄或网络稳定后恢复时间无界等问题，亟待解决。
AI.method: 1. 提出了一个新颖的协议无关抽象，用于形式化部分同步下领导者选举的通用正确性属性和有效性保证。2. 基于该抽象，设计了滑动窗口领导者选举（SWLE）机制，该机制通过基于共识行为的声誉评分动态调整领导者提名，并强制实施拜占庭成本放大。
AI.result: 1. SWLE对基础协议引入了极小的额外开销。2. 证明SWLE满足所有抽象属性并提供了卓越的有效性。3. 在中国北方4个不同地区的16台服务器部署实验中，与现有最先进的解决方案相比，SWLE在常见拜占庭故障下实现了高达4.2倍的吞吐量、75%的延迟降低和27%的拜占庭领导者频率，同时在无故障场景中保持了效率。
AI.conclusion: SWLE机制作为一种基于协议无关抽象设计的新型领导者选举方案，在部分同步BFT协议中表现出优越的有效性和效率，解决了现有基于声誉框架的协议特定性、适用性狭窄和恢复时间无界等局限性。
AI.translation: 领导者选举在基于领导者的拜占庭容错（BFT）协议中起着明确的作用。现有的用于部分同步BFT的基于声誉的领导者选举框架，要么存在协议特定的证明，要么适用性狭窄，要么在网络稳定后恢复时间无界，留下了一个未解决的问题。本文提出了一种新颖的协议无关抽象，形式化了部分同步下领导者选举的通用正确性属性和有效性保证，从而实现了协议无关的分析和设计。在此基础上，我们设计了滑动窗口领导者选举（SWLE）机制。SWLE通过基于共识行为的声誉评分动态调整领导者提名，并强制实施拜占庭成本放大。我们证明了SWLE对基础协议引入了极小的额外开销，并证明它满足所有的抽象属性并提供了卓越的有效性。我们展示了在中国北方4个不同地区的16台服务器部署中，与现有最先进的解决方案相比，SWLE在常见拜占庭故障下实现了高达4.2倍的吞吐量、75%的延迟降低和27%的拜占庭领导者频率，同时在无故障场景中保持了效率。
AI.summary: 针对现有部分同步拜占庭容错（BFT）协议中基于声誉的领导者选举机制存在的局限性，本文提出了一种协议无关的抽象模型，用于形式化领导者选举的通用属性和保证。基于此抽象，设计了滑动窗口领导者选举（SWLE）机制，该机制利用基于共识行为的声誉评分动态调整领导者提名。实验结果表明，SWLE在引入极小开销的同时，显著提高了系统在拜占庭故障下的吞吐量（高达4.2倍）和效率，并降低了恶意领导者的出现频率。
AI.keywords: 领导者选举, 拜占庭容错, 部分同步, 声誉系统, 协议无关抽象
AI.comments: 本文的核心创新在于提出了一个“协议无关的抽象”（Protocol-Independent Abstraction），这使得领导者选举机制的设计和分析可以脱离具体的BFT协议框架，提升了设计的通用性和理论分析的严谨性。滑动窗口领导者选举（SWLE）机制通过动态声誉评分和“拜占庭成本放大”策略，有效解决了现有方案中恢复慢和适用性窄的问题。实验数据显示该方案在实际部署中具有强大的性能优势（高达4.2倍吞吐量提升，75%延迟降低），对于提升基于领导者的BFT系统的鲁棒性和效率具有重要意义。

title: Mage: Cracking Elliptic Curve Cryptography with Cross-Axis Transformers
summary:
With the advent of machine learning and quantum computing, the 21st century has gone from a place of relative algorithmic security, to one of speculative unease and possibly, cyber catastrophe.
  Modern algorithms like Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) are the bastion of current cryptographic security protocols that form the backbone of consumer protection ranging from Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS) in the modern internet browser, to cryptographic financial instruments like Bitcoin.
  And there's been very little work put into testing the strength of these ciphers. Practically the only study that I could find was on side-channel recognition, a joint paper from the University of Milan, Italy and King's College, London\cite{battistello2025ecc}.
  These algorithms are already considered bulletproof by many consumers, but exploits already exist for them, and with computing power and distributed, federated compute on the rise, it's only a matter of time before these current bastions fade away into obscurity, and it's on all of us to stand up when we notice something is amiss, lest we see such passages claim victims in that process.
  In this paper, we seek to explore the use of modern language model architecture in cracking the association between a known public key, and its associated private key, by intuitively learning to reverse engineer the public keypair generation process, effectively solving the curve.
  Additonally, we attempt to ascertain modern machine learning's ability to memorize public-private secp256r1 keypairs, and to then test their ability to reverse engineer the public keypair generation process.
  It is my belief that proof-for would be equally valuable as proof-against in either of these categories.
  Finally, we'll conclude with some number crunching on where we see this particular field heading in the future.

AI.title_translation: Mage：使用跨轴Transformer破解椭圆曲线加密
AI.tldr: 本文提出使用现代语言模型架构（跨轴Transformer）来尝试逆向工程椭圆曲线加密（ECC）的公私钥生成过程，以测试其安全性，并探讨ML模型记忆secp256r1密钥对的能力。
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习和量子计算的出现，现代加密算法（如ECC，是HTTPS和比特币等系统的支柱）面临威胁，但对其强度测试的研究很少。许多人认为这些算法是万无一失的，但作者认为随着计算能力的增加，它们最终会失效，因此有必要测试其当前强度。
AI.method: 探索使用现代语言模型架构（暗示为跨轴Transformer）来破解已知公钥与其关联私钥之间的关联。具体方法是直观地学习逆向工程公钥对生成过程，从而“解决曲线”。此外，尝试确定现代机器学习模型记忆公私钥对（特指secp256r1）的能力，并测试其逆向工程公钥对生成过程的能力。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及具体的实验结论，但文章将以对该领域未来走向的数字分析作为总结。
AI.translation: 随着机器学习和量子计算的出现，21世纪已经从一个相对算法安全的时代，转变为一个充满推测性不安甚至可能发生网络灾难的时代。像椭圆曲线加密（ECC）这样的现代算法是当前加密安全协议的堡垒，构成了从现代互联网浏览器中的安全超文本协议（HTTPS）到像比特币这样的加密金融工具的消费者保护的支柱。然而，很少有工作投入到测试这些密码的强度中。实际上，我能找到的唯一研究是关于侧信道识别的，这是意大利米兰大学和伦敦国王学院的一篇联合论文。许多消费者已经认为这些算法是万无一失的，但漏洞已经存在，随着计算能力和分布式、联邦计算的兴起，这些当前的堡垒被淘汰只是时间问题，当我们发现问题时，我们都有责任站出来，以免我们看到此类通道在此过程中造成受害者。在本文中，我们试图探索使用现代语言模型架构来破解已知公钥及其关联私钥之间的关联，通过直观地学习逆向工程公钥对生成过程，从而有效地解决曲线问题。此外，我们尝试确定现代机器学习模型记忆公私钥secp256r1密钥对的能力，然后测试它们逆向工程公钥对生成过程的能力。我相信证明“支持”和证明“反对”在这些类别中的任何一个都具有同等价值。最后，我们将总结我们对该特定领域未来走向的一些数字分析。
AI.summary: 本文旨在测试椭圆曲线加密（ECC）的安全性，因为其面临来自机器学习和量子计算日益增长的威胁。作者提出使用现代语言模型架构（即“Mage”中的跨轴Transformer）来尝试逆向工程公钥对生成过程，从而从公钥推导出私钥。研究还包括评估机器学习模型记忆和逆向工程特定曲线（secp256r1）密钥对的能力。
AI.keywords: 椭圆曲线加密, Transformer, 语言模型, 密钥破解, secp256r1
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将现代语言模型架构（Transformer）应用于经典密码学破解问题——椭圆曲线离散对数问题的一个变种。虽然Transformer通常用于序列数据（如语言），将其应用于密钥对的数字结构是一种新颖的方法，可能揭示ECC在面对先进模式识别能力时的潜在漏洞。重要性在于它直接挑战了当前互联网安全支柱（如HTTPS和比特币）的核心安全性。然而，摘要中没有提供任何实验结果或模型性能指标，因此无法评估其方法的实际有效性和限制。

title: Adaptive Detector-Verifier Framework for Zero-Shot Polyp Detection in Open-World Settings
summary: Polyp detectors trained on clean datasets often underperform in real-world endoscopy, where illumination changes, motion blur, and occlusions degrade image quality. Existing approaches struggle with the domain gap between controlled laboratory conditions and clinical practice, where adverse imaging conditions are prevalent. In this work, we propose AdaptiveDetector, a novel two-stage detector-verifier framework comprising a YOLOv11 detector with a vision-language model (VLM) verifier. The detector adaptively adjusts per-frame confidence thresholds under VLM guidance, while the verifier is fine-tuned with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using an asymmetric, cost-sensitive reward function specifically designed to discourage missed detections -- a critical clinical requirement. To enable realistic assessment under challenging conditions, we construct a comprehensive synthetic testbed by systematically degrading clean datasets with adverse conditions commonly encountered in clinical practice, providing a rigorous benchmark for zero-shot evaluation. Extensive zero-shot evaluation on synthetically degraded CVC-ClinicDB and Kvasir-SEG images demonstrates that our approach improves recall by 14 to 22 percentage points over YOLO alone, while precision remains within 0.7 points below to 1.7 points above the baseline. This combination of adaptive thresholding and cost-sensitive reinforcement learning achieves clinically aligned, open-world polyp detection with substantially fewer false negatives, thereby reducing the risk of missed precancerous polyps and improving patient outcomes.

AI.title_translation: 开放世界设置下零样本息肉检测的自适应检测器-验证器框架
AI.tldr: 我们提出了AdaptiveDetector，一个两阶段框架（YOLOv11检测器+VLM验证器），利用自适应阈值和成本敏感的强化学习（GRPO），在零样本息肉检测中显著提高了召回率（14-22%），专门用于处理退化的真实世界图像并减少漏检。
AI.motivation: 现有息肉检测器在真实世界的内窥镜检查中，由于恶劣条件（光照变化、运动模糊、遮挡）导致图像质量下降，性能不佳。存在受控实验室条件与临床实践与之间的巨大域差距。目标是开发一个在开放世界设置中鲁棒的检测器，减少漏检这一关键临床问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为AdaptiveDetector的新型两阶段检测器-验证器框架。检测器（YOLOv11）在VLM的指导下自适应地调整每帧置信度阈值。验证器通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）和一个旨在惩罚漏检的非对称、成本敏感奖励函数进行微调。此外，他们构建了一个通过系统性退化干净数据集的综合合成测试平台用于零样本评估。
AI.result: 在合成退化的CVC-ClinicDB和Kvasir-SEG图像上进行的零样本评估显示，该方法相比单独使用YOLO，召回率提高了14至22个百分点。准确率保持在基线上下0.7至1.7个百分点范围内。
AI.conclusion: 自适应阈值设定和成本敏感的强化学习相结合，实现了临床一致的开放世界息肉检测，显著减少了假阴性，从而降低了漏检癌前息肉的风险并改善了患者预后。
AI.translation: 息肉检测器在干净数据集上训练后，在真实世界的内窥镜检查中往往表现不佳，因为光照变化、运动模糊和遮挡等因素会降低图像质量。现有方法难以应对受控实验室条件与临床实践之间的域差距，而恶劣的成像条件在临床实践中普遍存在。在这项工作中，我们提出了AdaptiveDetector，一种新颖的两阶段检测器-验证器框架，它包含一个YOLOv11检测器和一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）验证器。该检测器在VLM的指导下自适应地调整每帧置信度阈值，而验证器通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行微调，使用专门设计用于阻止漏检（这是一个关键的临床要求）的非对称、成本敏感的奖励函数。为了在挑战性条件下实现真实的评估，我们构建了一个综合的合成测试平台，通过系统性地使用临床实践中常见的恶劣条件来退化干净数据集，为零样本评估提供了一个严格的基准。在合成退化的CVC-ClinicDB和Kvasir-SEG图像上进行的广泛零样本评估表明，我们的方法相比单独使用YOLO，召回率提高了14到22个百分点，而准确率保持在基线上下0.7到1.7个百分点范围内。这种自适应阈值设定和成本敏感强化学习的结合，实现了临床一致的开放世界息肉检测，显著减少了假阴性，从而降低了漏检癌前息肉的风险并改善了患者预后。
AI.summary: AdaptiveDetector是一种针对开放世界零样本息肉检测的创新两阶段框架，结合了YOLOv11检测器和VLM验证器。它通过VLM指导下的自适应阈值调整和使用GRPO及成本敏感奖励函数的验证器微调，解决了真实世界内窥镜图像质量差的问题。该方法在合成退化数据集上的零样本评估中表现出色，召回率比基线提高了14-22个百分点，显著减少了临床上关键的漏检情况。
AI.keywords: Adaptive Detector, Zero-Shot Polyp Detection, Vision-Language Model, Reinforcement Learning, GRPO
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一个高度实用的框架，解决了模型在临床环境中鲁棒性的关键问题。其创新点在于将成熟的目标检测器（YOLOv11）与VLM验证器相结合，允许在丰富的语义信息指导下进行自适应决策（阈值调整）。此外，使用GRPO和成本敏感奖励函数，明确优先减少假阴性（漏检息肉），是一个至关重要且符合临床需求的贡献。为严格的零样本评估构建合成测试平台也是迈向现实基准测试的重要一步。

title: Linear Codes with Certain Dimension of Hermitian Hulls
comments: There is some overlap in content with existing papers. See "A further study on the mass formula for linear codes with prescribed hull dimension"
summary: In this paper, we study the enumerative and asymptotic properties related to Hermitian $\ell$-complementary codes on the unitary space over $\F_{q^2}$. We provide some closed form expressions for the counting formulas of Hermitian $\ell$-complementary codes. There is a similarity in the asymptotic weight distribution between Hermitian self-orthogonal codes and unrestricted codes. Furthermore, we study the asymptotic behavior of Hermitian self-orthogonal codes whose minimum distance is at least $d$. In particular, we conclude that MDS codes within the class of Hermitian self-orthogonal codes are asymptotically dense when the alphabet size approaches to infinity.
comment: There is some overlap in content with existing papers. See "A further study on the mass formula for linear codes with prescribed hull dimension"

AI.title_translation: 具有特定维度厄米特壳的线性码
AI.tldr: 本文研究了厄米特 $\ell$-互补码的计数和渐近性质，提供了计数公式。结果显示厄米特自正交码与非限制码在渐近权重分布上相似，并证明了在字母表大小趋于无穷时，厄米特自正交码中的MDS码是渐近稠密的。
AI.motivation: 研究有限域 $\F_{q^2}$ 上酉空间中厄米特 $\ell$-互补码的枚举和渐近性质。
AI.method: 提供了厄米特 $\ell$-互补码计数公式的封闭形式表达式；分析了厄米特自正交码的渐近权重分布和最小距离至少为 $d$ 的渐近行为。
AI.result: 1. 提供了厄米特 $\ell$-互补码计数公式的封闭形式表达式。2. 厄米特自正交码与非限制码在渐近权重分布上存在相似性。3. 证明了当字母表大小趋于无穷时，厄米特自正交码类别中的MDS码是渐近稠密的。
AI.conclusion: 当字母表大小趋于无穷时，厄米特自正交码类别中的MDS码是渐近稠密的。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了有限域 $\F_{q^2}$ 上酉空间中与厄米特 $\ell$-互补码相关的枚举和渐近性质。我们为厄米特 $\ell$-互补码的计数公式提供了一些封闭形式的表达式。厄米特自正交码和非限制码在渐近权重分布上存在相似性。此外，我们研究了最小距离至少为 $d$ 的厄米特自正交码的渐近行为。特别是，我们得出结论，当字母表大小趋于无穷时，厄米特自正交码类别中的MDS码是渐近稠密的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有限域 $\F_{q^2}$ 上酉空间中厄米特 $\ell$-互补码的枚举和渐近特性。研究工作给出了此类代码计数公式的封闭形式表达式，并指出厄米特自正交码与非限制码在渐近权重分布上表现出相似性。此外，文章还分析了最小距离至少为 $d$ 的厄米特自正交码的渐近行为，并最终得出结论：当字母表大小趋于无穷时，厄米特自正交码中的MDS码是渐近稠密的。
AI.keywords: 厄米特 $\ell$-互补码, 渐近性质, 计数公式, 厄米特自正交码, MDS码
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于系统地分析了厄米特 $\ell$-互补码和厄米特自正交码的枚举和渐近性质。特别值得注意的是，它提供了精确的计数公式，并建立了厄米特自正交码与非限制码在渐近权重分布上的联系。证明MDS码在特定条件下是渐近稠密的，对于理解和构造具有良好参数的自正交码具有重要的理论意义。标题中提到的“具有特定维度厄米特壳的线性码”这一概念在摘要中转化为对 $\ell$-互补码和自正交码的研究，这表明厄米特 $\ell$-互补码是具有特定厄米特壳维度的一类代码。

title: Beyond Task Completion: An Assessment Framework for Evaluating Agentic AI Systems
summary: Recent advances in agentic AI have shifted the focus from standalone Large Language Models (LLMs) to integrated systems that combine LLMs with tools, memory, and other agents to perform complex tasks. These multi-agent architectures enable coordinated reasoning, planning, and execution across diverse domains, allowing agents to collaboratively automate complex workflows. Despite these advances, evaluation and assessment of LLM agents and the multi-agent systems they constitute remain a fundamental challenge.
